trust_decision.summary: Jws.verify_jwk decides whether an RS256 signature is valid for the signing input (header.payload). The published fix replaces a decode-only sig_decode check with PKCS1.verify against input_str; at the pinned commit that check is ALREADY in place (in a later, evolved form), so the pinned tree is not vulnerable to this fix.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'missing RSA signature verification'; verify_jwk's Rsa_priv/Rsa_pub arms are the only RSA verification code.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route found; the private-key arm (jose/Jws.ml:109) could be dismissed as 'verifiers use public keys', but it already verifies at the pinned commit.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: RS384/RS512 tokens and alg-less JWKs must still validate via rsa_validate_hash; an over-strict fix pinning SHA256 would break them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: verify_internal rebuilding signing input from re-encoded payload instead of the raw received segment (identity differential)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Compact parser keeps raw_header but decodes payload (jose/Jws.ml:17-21); a maintainer could plausibly drop raw handling for the JSON path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: General JSON serialization (signatures[] array) parsed without verifying each/any entry
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: of_json_string only reads top-level 'signature'; adding General-format multi-signature support is a TODO (jose/Jws.ml:73) where a lax verifier is easy to write.

O9_family: signature verification bypass (CWE-347, improper verification of cryptographic signature)

O10_build.project_tests: alcotest suites test/JWSTest.ml, test/RFC7515.ml, test/RFC7520.ml, test/JWTTest.ml

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace sig_decode with PKCS1.verify in the Rsa_pub arm only, leaving Rsa_priv decode-only.

out_of_scope_notes: Jws.validate checks header alg is supported but dispatches verification on the caller's JWK type, not the header alg (jose/Jws.ml:215-230); not pursued.
EC arms split the signature at fixed lengths without a length check (jose/Jws.ml:148, 165, 182); not pursued.
